Dad was driving us to a lake. We were sitting in the car and getting bored. As we were arriving, we started seeing our friends. Some were swimming, and one hopped on rocks. Parents were making a tasty lunch and taking care of babies. As the sun was setting, we hated leaving and hugged our friends. Papá nos llevaba en carro a un lago. Estábamos sentados en el carro y nos aburríamos. Mientras llegábamos, empezamos a ver a nuestros amigos. Algunos nadaban y uno saltaba sobre las rocas.
